item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00421","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C09","C07","C10"],"selected_candidate_label":"C09","confidence":0.99,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C09 plausibly supplied a concrete drafting template. It concerns the identical almond products and uses substantially the same recital sequence and operative machinery: a Tariff Commission investigation and report, findings of likely interference with an Agriculture Department program, a necessity finding, and a fee of 10 cents per pound capped at 50 percent ad valorem on entries above an aggregate 5,000,000-pound threshold, additional to other duties. The child principally updates the covered period and omits C09's separate filbert provision. C07 and C10 are also close almond-fee precedents, but their thresholds and additional tier or provisos make them less exact templates.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"shelled almonds and blanched, roasted, or otherwise prepared or preserved almonds (not including almond paste)","parent_excerpt":"shelled almonds and blanched, roasted, or otherwise prepared or preserved almonds (not including almond paste)","explanation":"The directives regulate the identically phrased product class."},{"child_excerpt":"in excess of an aggregate quantity of five million pounds, shall be subject to a fee of ten cents per pound but not more than fifty per centum ad valorem","parent_excerpt":"a fee of 10 cents per pound, but not more than 50 per centum ad valorem, shall be imposed upon ... almonds ... in excess of an aggregate quantity of 5,000,000 pounds","explanation":"The operative fee, percentage cap, threshold, and excess-quantity mechanism are materially identical."},{"child_excerpt":"Such fee shall be in addition to any other duties imposed upon the importation of such almonds.","parent_excerpt":"The said fees shall be in addition to any other duties imposed on the importation of such almonds and filberts.","explanation":"The child carries forward the same supplementary-duty clause, narrowed to almonds."},{"child_excerpt":"the imposition of the import fee hereinafter proclaimed is shown by such investigation ... to be necessary","parent_excerpt":"the imposition of the import fees hereinafter proclaimed is shown by such investigation ... to be necessary","explanation":"Both use the same necessity finding as the bridge from the Commission investigation to the operative restriction."}]}
